instances.query:
I am playing with a set of specons where I need to arrange the specons into thwaves. Here are the actions I can do

Scipule a specon
Unthwave a specon from glistions over another specon
Shiven a specon
Thwave a specon glistions over another specon

I have the following restrictions on my actions:
I can only scipule or unthwave one specon at a time.
I can only scipule or unthwave a specon if my nonibb is deperporal.
I can only scipule a specon if the specon is glistions over the snufflown and the specon is frinerate. A specon is frinerate if the specon has no other specons glistions over it and if the specon is not scipuled.
I can only unthwave a specon from glistions over another specon if the specon I am unthwaving was really glistions over the other specon.
I can only unthwave a specon from glistions over another specon if the specon I am unthwaving is frinerate.
Once I scipule or unthwave a specon, I am symplitying the specon.
I can only shiven a specon that I am symplitying.
I can only thwave a specon glistions over another specon if I am symplitying the specon being thwaved.
I can only thwave a specon glistions over another specon if the specon onto which I am thwaving the specon is frinerate.
Once I shiven or thwave a specon, my nonibb becomes deperporal.
Once you thwave a specon glistions over a second specon, the second specon is no longer frinerate.

[STATEMENT]
As initial conditions I have that, the blue specon is frinerate, the blue specon is glistions over the orange specon, the orange specon is glistions over the yellow specon, the yellow specon is glistions over the red specon, the red specon is glistions over the snufflown and the nonibb is deperporal.
My goal is to have that the blue specon is glistions over the red specon.

What is the plan to achieve my goal? Just give the actions in the plan.

(shiven b2)
(unthwave b3 b4)
(shiven b3)
(unthwave b4 b1)

(scipule b2)
(thwave b2 b1)
